scope: Read-only chapter-asset and helper-vector QA. This report contains repository-relative paths and public image hashes only. No browser, app, deployment, or VPS behavior was tested.

warnings.detail: Some selected comics use four equal rectangular panels on a landscape canvas. The reader must derive framing from each actual image dimension rather than force square scaling.

visualInspections.notes: Four chronological scenes; Soraya is a fox astronomer with circlet and telescope, Zephyr a small gentle ochre dragon, Rook has red face, scarf, satchel and lantern. Local collaborators participate in the outcome.

Four chronological garden scenes; readable character actions and a respected boundary. The final gathering is an invitation, with no baked dialogue. Rook, Lin and local friends retain the series look.

Four scenes show Bun, Misha and Dasha. Dasha is a silver-grey fox-like librarian in a cream coat and navy scarf. Rook wears a plain winter hat outdoors and removes it in the warm interior; his red face and white eye patch remain recognizable.
Four quiet library/source-preservation scenes. The missing teaching sheet is visible. No weapons, readable document text or national insignia are embedded.
Four distinct flight scenes. The selected final passenger panel shows a fastened lap belt, underseat luggage and an unlit secured brass lantern.

Final corrected handoff shows Jo as a raccoon in a plum vest, matching America/open-bench. The original tan-rabbit handoff was replaced; the selected public artwork retains two cups and the letter handoff.
Jo is the same raccoon/plum-vest design at arrival and in the archive, consistent with the final Russian handoff.
